description: Four filter cores, each switchable between low pass, high pass and band pass, with a crossfading scanner that sweeps one output across the four

params.text: Sets that channel's cutoff frequency, 20Hz to 20kHz
Sets that channel's resonance, from none at fully counter-clockwise to the edge of self-oscillation at fully clockwise
Switched to RES that channel's FM2/RES input reaches the resonance; switched to FM2 it reaches the cutoff instead
Sets that channel's response: LP is a 4-pole low pass, HP a 2-pole high pass, BP a 4-pole band pass
Moves the SCAN output across the four filter outputs; at each end only one channel reaches it, and between two positions both of the channels it lies between reach it

inputs.text: The signal that channel filters; leave it unpatched and the channel takes whatever reached the input above it
Modulates that channel's cutoff, one octave per volt; leave it unpatched and the channel takes whatever reached the frequency input above it
Reaches that channel's resonance or its cutoff, according to that channel's CV destination switch; as a resonance CV it is clamped to ±5V
Moves the scan, a tenth of a volt for each hundredth of the sweep, added to the SCAN slider

outputs.text: That channel's filtered signal in whichever of the three responses its mode switch has chosen
The four filter outputs added at the shares the scan gives them

notes: the four signal inputs cascade: a channel with nothing patched reads the channel above it, and channel 1 with nothing patched reads 0V. The four FREQ inputs cascade the same way.
menu: Clip Output ±10V — holds the filter outputs inside ±10V; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
